findings.source_quote: Claiming His love on me overlying.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace the line with “En maak aanspraak op sy liefde wat oor my rus.” This preserves the source’s idea of claiming his love rather than trusting in it.
findings.translation_quote: En vertrou op sy liefde wat oor my rus.

findings.source_quote: Yet the promise remains, all works out well,
findings.suggested_fix: Replace the line with “Tog bly die belofte staan: alles loop goed af,” to retain the source’s assurance that things turn out well, without changing it to the distinct claim that everything works for good.
findings.translation_quote: Tog bly die belofte staan: alles werk ten goede uit,

findings.suggested_fix: Replace with “Soms betrap ek myself dat ek droom,” for idiomatic Afrikaans.
Replace “Goed gedaan” with the idiomatic Afrikaans “Mooi so” in the quotation: “Om daardie woorde te hoor: ‘Mooi so.’”
findings.translation_quote: Om daardie woorde te hoor: “Goed gedaan.”
